description: Create a payment request: who receives, which token, how much, on which network. Returns invoice.id, invoice.label (INV-XXXX-XXXX, what people copy), invoice.url (share this, after paying the analysis charge if the invoice has one; it previews with the QR on WhatsApp and Telegram) and invoice.qr (PNG). No signature or API key needed. New invoices only receive VERIFIED dollar stablecoins on the network allowlist, even without paid analysis. A new invoice without payerChecks carries no fee; with payerChecks, the analysis fee of both wallets is deducted from the amount through the split (see payerChecks). Previously created invoices keep their terms. Tokens resolve by address or symbol — an unverified token is refused because a cloned "USDC" with its own pool would let the creator sell a fake at any price. The payer can pay with ANY token on that network. Paid checks in checks are closed for new invoices (paid_check_moved): use payerChecks. the free screening of the receiving wallet must pass for the invoice to be created (receiver_blocked 403, screening_unavailable 503), and payerChecks adds the paid analysis of both wallets, paid by the fee deducted from the amount.

amount.description: Human decimal amount, e.g. "100". Decimals come from the token list, not from you.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checks.description: Closed for new invoices (07/11/2026): a paid check here ("scorechain", "merkle-science") is refused with paid_check_moved, on every network. Use payerChecks for the analysis of the paying wallet, and the payer buys the analysis of the receiving wallet with invoice_analysis_pay. Invoices created before keep their charge, paid by the creator with invoice_analysis_pay. Any other value is refused with invalid_check.

confidential.description: Not available yet: private invoices are coming soon, with the Vurto Private Contract. Any value other than false is refused with private_coming_soon and nothing is created. A payment is a direct transfer, so the transaction shows the receiving wallet on-chain; omit this field.

memo.description: Optional note, up to 80 chars, visible to anyone with the link.

payerChecks.description: Solana and EVM networks with invoiceSplit=true in /v1/chains, stablecoin invoices only: USDC, USDT (including USDT0), PYUSD, USDG and USD1, by verified address on each network. Availability differs by network. You (the receiver) choose the PAID analysis of the PAYER wallet; your own wallet goes through the same tools. One analysis fee covers both wallets, the same with one tool or two: a share of the amount by brackets (https://docs.vurto.cc/fees), deducted from the amount through the split. invoice.split comes back with rule "brackets", fee and receiverAmount: the payer sends the amount and you receive receiverAmount. There is no charge to pay first, so the link can be shared right away. Below the minimum: amount_below_analysis_minimum (400, details.minimum). It runs when the payer calls invoice_pay, after the free screening passes, and no field switches it off. The result goes to you alone, on the site, signed in with this wallet: invoice_get here does not carry it. Refused: split_not_available_on_chain where no split contract is configured, stablecoin_required for tokens outside the network allowlist, amount_below_analysis_minimum below the minimum, analysis_tool_unavailable (503) when the tool is not answering, and nothing is created or charged.

recipient.description: Who receives: a wallet (EVM 0x address, or base58 on Solana, case-sensitive) or a Vurto user as "@handle". With "@handle" the Vurto Profile picks one of that user's wallets on this network (random among the ones they marked for regular or, with confidential, private transfers; the rotation only moves after a confirmed payment), the invoice carries recipientHandle, and the free screening runs on the wallet picked. On a regular invoice the payment transaction still carries that wallet; only the private one keeps it from the payer. recipient_unavailable (400) is the same answer for a handle that does not exist and one with no wallet on this network.

token.description: Token to receive: address/mint or symbol of a verified dollar stablecoin on the network allowlist. Other tokens return stablecoin_required, even without paid analysis.

name: invoice_create
